reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his direct message with me and confirmed that Tamsyn Tolland is now his go-to escalation contact at Quarrendon Freight Lines for the Greywater rollout.

The workspace knowledge brain saves each direct message automatically and shows it only to the member who sent it. So his note is stored where only he can see it, and he can ask for it later. I didn't save an extra copy in the brain or take any other action, as he asked.
